title: ATTACK A (round 2) -- COMBINE THE ARMS THAT ALREADY EXIST.  Pre-registration.
written_before: any new estimator was run.  The per-arm accuracies quoted below are ALL published round-1 numbers (openstrong_bestofn_2026-08-10.json, cost_floor_2026-08-10.json, cascade_selector_rerun_2026-08-05.json); no new number informed this file.
goal: beat always-32B-direct on the 8-cell MACRO (Variant B, equal weight 1/8 per cell) with a 95% CI excluding zero, using an HONEST estimator of a per-cell arm-selection policy.

serving_config_matching_RULE.problem: round-1 standing caveat -- regenerating the 32B greedy open-text arm under a different tensor-parallel configuration reproduces the published open cells only to about +/-0.008 per cell (+0.00183 macro), which is LARGER than the entire published +0.0008 delta.
serving_config_matching_RULE.rule: an arm may only be compared against a baseline generated in the SAME serving run.  The three 32B best-of-N arms were generated by src/cascade_methods/openstrong_gen.py (tp=1) together with their own greedy control ckpt_{ds}_l32_n1.jsonl.  Therefore, in the frame that contains them, the open-cell always-32B-direct column is REPLACED by that same-runner control.
serving_config_matching_RULE.consequence: the bar RISES on the open cells (SLAKE_open 0.8186 -> 0.8202, VQA_RAD_open 0.6000 -> 0.6050, PATH_VQA_open 0.3760 -> 0.3840; macro bar 0.6567 -> 0.6585).  This is the conservative direction and it is accepted.

frames.M_MATCHED_HEADLINE: open-cell always_32b_direct := the same-runner l32_n1 control.  Menu INCLUDES the three 32B best-of-N arms.  Every 32B number in an open cell comes from ONE serving run.  THIS IS THE HEADLINE FRAME.
frames.P_PUBLISHED_ROBUSTNESS: open-cell always_32b_direct := the published vec_disjoint column.  Menu EXCLUDES the 32B best-of-N arms (config-unmatched).  Must reproduce cost_floor_2026-08-10.json:crossfit_frontier.
frames.X_MIXED_DIAGNOSTIC: published bar + best-of-N arms on the menu.  UNMATCHED and therefore NOT a result; reported only to quantify how much of any apparent gain is serving-config drift rather than method.

arm_menu.menu_is_pre_specified_conditional_on_rou: ALL three best-of-N arms measured in round 1 are placed on ALL THREE open cells, not only on the cell where round 1 saw a win.  The decision to include the family at all is nevertheless an eval-visible menu-level choice that no cross-fit can undo; it is declared as the largest honesty caveat of this attack and is repeated in the artifact.

EXCLUDED_and_why.mcq_tta_gated: cannot be item-paired to the full cells -- it covers PMC_VQA n=6000 of 33430 and MedXpertQA-MM n=63 of 2000 (mcq_tta_2026-08-10.json:per_cell).  Its own deployable summed MCQ gain is +0.0000622, i.e. +0.0000078 macro, below any resolution here.
EXCLUDED_and_why.open_diverse_DPP: round 1 measured it as a CLEAN LOSS (SLAKE_open -0.0748 [-0.1031,-0.0474]); it is a retired claim, not an arm.
EXCLUDED_and_why.32B_best_of_N_on_MCQ_cells: never generated -- the pools exist only for the three open cells.

estimators.E0_naive_evalvisible: per cell, the arm with the highest FULL-EVAL accuracy.  DIAGNOSTIC ONLY -- upper bound, reported so the shrinkage is visible.
estimators.E1_crossfit_argmax: 5-fold cross-fit.  Per cell per fold: pick the most accurate arm on the four TRAINING folds; answer the held-out fold with it.  Identical rule to cost_floor_2026-08-10.json:crossfit_frontier at eps=0.
estimators.E2_nested_margin_HEADLINE: incumbent-default with a NESTED margin.  always_32b_direct is the incumbent; a challenger is deployed on a held-out fold only if its TRAINING-fold accuracy exceeds the incumbent's by at least m.  m is chosen on INNER folds of the training data only (grid below).  Outer folds give the estimate.  THIS IS THE PRE-REGISTERED HEADLINE ESTIMATOR.
estimators.E3_nested_cost_aware: cost endpoint.  Nested CV in which eps (the accuracy slack traded for cost) is chosen on inner folds; the cheapest arm within eps of the best training-fold arm is deployed.  Same rule as cost_floor's PRIMARY_ENDPOINT_HONEST_NESTED_CV, on the enlarged menu.

seeds.generation_seed_limitation: only 3 independent vLLM generation seeds of the 32B 8-sample pool exist (they cost GPU; round 1 produced s0/s1/s2).  Methodology rule 4 asks for >=10 where sampling is involved.  The 3 available seeds are reported with mean/sd/range and the headline is the GENERATION-SEED-AVERAGED value; if the headline lands within one generation-seed sd of the bar, that is declared a limitation rather than papered over.
seeds.reported: mean / sd / range over fold seeds, and separately over generation seeds

permutation_null.why: with 8 cells and up to 9 arms, 'pick the best arm per cell' has real selection bias.  It must be MEASURED, not assumed away.
permutation_null.construction: EXCHANGEABILITY NULL.  For each cell independently, and for each ITEM independently, apply a uniformly random permutation of the arm labels to that item's vector of 0/1 outcomes.  This preserves, exactly, the per-item multiset of outcomes (hence the realistic inter-arm correlation and the per-item difficulty structure) while making every arm slot exchangeable, i.e. equal in expected accuracy.  The whole estimator is then re-run on the permuted menu and the macro delta is taken against whatever arm now occupies the always_32b_direct slot.
permutation_null.reported: null mean, sd, 2.5/50/97.5 percentiles, and a one-sided permutation p-value for each estimator

statistics.bootstrap: paired item-level, nboot=10000, ONE shared resample stream per cell reused by every policy and every baseline (grouped-multinomial shortcut over the full correctness signature, the same device cost_floor uses)

cost.primary_convention: A_as_charged (paper constants; one 32B forward = R32, one 7B generation or verifier forward = 1.0)

new_arm_charges_as_charged.l32_bo4: 4 x 32B generations + 4 x 7B verifier forwards = 4*1.0 + 4*R32 (= 22.28 at R32=4.57, matching openstrong_bestofn_2026-08-10.json:cost.open_cell_per_item.32b_bo4.total_as_charged_flopeq)
new_arm_charges_as_charged.l32_maj8: 8 x 32B generations, NO verifier = 8*R32 (= 36.56); majority voting is training-free

cost.conventions_B_C: reported but flagged UNCORROBORATED -- cost_floor_2026-08-10.json:VERDICT.kill_criteria.i shows vLLM V1 implements SamplingParams(n=N) as N child requests relying on prefix caching, not a post-prefill fork, so the shared-prefill premise is unverified.
cost.latency_energy: NOT MEASURED for any policy that deploys a 32B best-of-N arm (openstrong_bestofn_2026-08-10.json:cost.provenance says so explicitly).  Such policies will report FLOP-eq only and the string 'not measured' for latency and energy.  Policies drawn only from previously measured arms carry cost_floor's measured constants.

SUCCESS_criteria: S1: E2 (nested margin, frame M, generation-seed-averaged) macro delta vs always-32B-direct has a 95% CI whose lower bound is > 0
S2: the permutation-null one-sided p-value for that same estimator is < 0.05
S3: no per-cell guardrail flag (no cell significantly worse than always-32B-direct)
KILL_criteria: K1: the honest nested delta's 95% CI covers zero -> report the negative plainly and fall back to the best honest COST point
K2: the permutation null's 97.5th percentile is >= the observed honest delta -> the gain is selection bias, say so
K3: the honest gain survives ONLY in frame X (published bar + unmatched best-of-N arms) -> the 'gain' is serving-config drift, report as a null
secondary_endpoint: the cheapest policy that still TIES always-32B-direct (pre-registered tie = bootstrap lower bound >= -0.0029), on the enlarged menu, since round 1 showed cost is the more tractable endpoint.  Reported with its as-charged x_direct under both R32 values.
